title: Body Surface Area Calculator
description: Compute body surface area with the DuBois formula (plus Mosteller for reference).
howto: Read your BSA by the DuBois formula.
Compare with the Mosteller estimate shown for reference.

faqs.a: BSA = 0.007184 x weight^0.425 x height^0.725, with weight in kg and height in cm. Published in 1916, still widely used in medicine.
Chemotherapy dosing, burn size assessment, cardiac index, and renal function estimates, among others.
Mosteller (square root of weight x height / 3600) is simpler and very close to DuBois; clinicians often cross-check with it.
